# Jaison David

> Official portfolio of Jaison David, a Backend & Distributed Systems Engineer and Full-Stack Developer.

## Identity

- Name: Jaison David
- Alternate name: Jaison David M
- Focus: Go (Gin), distributed systems, event-driven architectures, REST APIs, Redis, Apache Kafka, MySQL, Docker, React, and Next.js
- Education: B.E. in Computer Science & Engineering at Bannari Amman Institute of Technology (2025–2029)

## Projects

- [Interview Portal](https://github.com/jaisondavid-m/Interview-Portal): Distributed technical interview and lab engineering platform using Go, React, MySQL, Redis, Docker, Nginx, and WebRTC.
- [BitCentral](https://github.com/jaisondavid-m/bitcentral-v2): Full-stack institutional data platform. [Live demo](https://bitcentral.bitsathy.in)
- [ZeroProxyAttendance](https://github.com/jaisondavid-m/ZeroProxyAttendance): QR attendance and anti-proxy system using cryptographic handshakes, GPS geofencing, and campus network validation.
- [Ticket Booking System](https://github.com/jaisondavid-m/Ticket-Booking-System): Distributed ticket booking backend using Redis, Kafka, MySQL, and Go.
